meta.name: design-md
meta.description: Analyze Stitch projects and synthesize a semantic design system into DESIGN.md files

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Stitch 项目并生成语义设计系统文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 Stitch 并需要自动生成设计系统文档
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Stitch projects and generate semantic design system documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Stitch and need to automatically generate design system documentation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会分析Stitch项目中的屏幕，提取颜色、几何形状、层次等设计元素，并生成一份名为DESIGN.md的文档，用于保持新屏幕与现有设计语言一致。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude分析一个Stitch项目并生成设计系统文档，或提供项目ID和屏幕ID时触发。

say.text: 分析我的家具收藏项目，生成设计系统文件。

say.note: 如果未提供项目ID，Claude会先查找项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Stitch screens, extracts design tokens (colors, shapes, depth), and generates a DESIGN.md file that serves as a single source of truth for prompting new screens to match the existing design language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze a Stitch project and generate a design system file, or when you provide a project ID and screen ID.

say_en.text: Analyze my Furniture Collection project and generate a design system file.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the project and create DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: Please create a DESIGN.md for my Stitch project.
say_en.note: If no project ID, Claude will list projects first.
